text: Unified icons: Lucide instead of Unicode/emoji glyphs

status.comment: d3a9435. pnpm check 25/25. Checked live: project selection pencils, header (columns −/+, search, info, menu, maximize, commit, hourglass, settings, consistency check, refresh), watchdog actions overlay (all 10 icons render). Not looked at: consistency modal, terminal key pad on mobile, voice view. Key hints (← H, → L) and toast ×N stay text.

description: About 70 glyphs in 17 components (six kinds of ×, emoji mixed with symbols) rendered differently per platform and ignored the text color. Replaced with lucide-vue-next components; one svg.lucide rule in style.css sizes them to the text and draws them in its color. Watchdog and loop panels were also made exclusive (006170d).
